recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF).
2. Add a yellow circle in the top-right corner with the number '36'.
3. On the left side, create a 4-row x 2-column grid of panels. In each of the first 7 cells, add a red-bordered panel with a red header bar containing white bold text 'Threshold=X.X' (values: 0.0, 0.6, 0.1, 0.7, 0.3, 1, 0.4 in reading order). Inside each panel, add a 2x2 confusion matrix with header 'Predicted as' and column labels P, N; row header 'Actual' and row labels P, N. Fill matrix cells with the exact numbers from each panel. To the right of each matrix, add a text box with TPR and FPR formulas exactly as transcribed.
4. In the 8th cell (bottom-right of the left grid), add a light blue/gray box with dark border containing the text 'ROC Curve for Same Model -different thresholds'.
5. On the right side, create a large panel with a light blue grid background. Draw X-axis labeled 'FPR' and Y-axis labeled 'TPR'. Draw a purple curve from bottom-right to top-left. Add a green dot at the top-left. Add white circular nodes along the curve with labels: 0.7 near bottom-left, 0.6, 0.4, 0.3, 0.1, 0.0 near top-right, and 1.0 at bottom-right axis. Add red annotation arrows labeled 'Best (TPR)' and 'Best (FPR)'. Add a green arrow annotation 'The Best (If Any)' pointing to the top-left corner.
6. In the bottom-right corner below the ROC panel, add two text boxes with formulas: 'TPR = TP / (TP + FN)' and 'FPR = FP / (FP + TN)'. Below them, add a small 2x2 confusion matrix with header 'Predicted as' (P, N) and row header 'Actual' (P, N). Fill cells: TP (green background), FN (red background), FP (red background), TN (green background).
7. Use black sans-serif text for all body content. Use white bold text on red (#C00000) for panel headers.
